decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 5 - The application for the installation of and replacement of non-illuminated signage on Sainsbury's building and throughout the car park and security area, as shown on drawings numbered CHQ.06.4820-103 D, CHQ.06.7031-02 B, and CHQ.06.7031-03 A, and within 'Chiswick proposed signage' booklet/schedule pages 1-12, all received 24th October 2006, would, by reason of its size, position and design, be of satisfactory appearance and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the building and street scene and have no impact on public safety. The proposal would comply with policies, ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Installation of and replacement of non-illuminated signage on Sainsbury's building and throughout the car park and security area.
